machine: Apple M1 Max, 32 GB unified memory

case.prompt: A red fox asleep beside a mossy stone in soft morning light.

tokenizer.implementation: Native NFC, pinned Unicode pre-tokenizer regex, GPT-2 byte mapping, ranked BPE, added-special-token recognition, raw T2I chat template
coverage: leading, repeated, tab, and trailing whitespace
added special tokens inside prompt text

text_encoder.weights: Original four BF16 Safetensors shards mapped into Metal without copying
text_encoder.path: Text-only language model; vision tower, final RMSNorm, and LM head are not executed
text_encoder.architecture: 36 layers, width 4096, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head dimension 128, SwiGLU width 12288, theta 5000000
text_encoder.activation_semantics: FP32 computation with explicit round-to-nearest-even BF16 storage boundaries

reference_variation.interpretation: The reference MPS backend itself moves the pre-final-RMSNorm representation by 3.28% between the two measured Torch versions. The native 4% gate is therefore local to this conditioning boundary and must be followed by a downstream denoiser/image gate before claiming prompt-equivalent generation.

rejected_path.description: Keeping FP32 activations between language-model operations
rejected_path.reason: Error accumulated from 0% at embedding to 9.21% at layer 35 against the Torch 2.8 boundary fixture. Explicit BF16 storage semantics reduced the pinned final error to 3.61%.

limitations: The native text-encoder output is not yet handed to the denoiser; the existing image command still reads committed prompt embeddings.
The four complete checkpoint shards remain mapped for this correctness path even though the vision tower and LM head are not touched.
Text-encoder quantization has not been calibrated, and the 17.5 GB mapping must be released before opening the 12.42 GB denoiser mapping.
Only a single unpadded prompt is executed natively; fixture metadata records exact left-padded batch IDs and masks for the later batching boundary.
